lesson.summary: ship/ship-spike never state whether a docs-only diff should bump the plugin version
lesson.synthesized_rule: The ship pipelines are silent on version bumping, so the agent must infer policy from git history each time. State the predicate explicitly: bump when the diff touches shipped plugin artifacts; do not bump for docs-only or dev-tooling-only diffs. Silence here produces either a spurious published version with no behavior change, or an agent overriding an explicit human instruction on inferred convention.
